# TotemEnchanting

Make the books inside Chiseled Bookshelves matter to your enchanting setup. Filled shelves contribute enchanting power, giving you a reason to collect books and arrange a working library around your Enchanting Table.

## How it works

- Each normal book contributes one point of power.
- An enchanted book contributes the sum of its enchantment levels.
- Valid shelves combine up to 64 power. Particles show contributing shelves.
- Higher power can improve enchantment selection while keeping Minecraft's item and enchantment compatibility rules. It does not guarantee a particular enchantment or add custom enchantment IDs.

Place Chiseled Bookshelves in valid vanilla bookshelf positions around an Enchanting Table, leave the gap unobstructed, and insert normal or enchanted books. Open the table to use the resulting options. Displayed level requirements can exceed 30, so check the cost before enchanting.

## Installation

Install this mod, Fabric API, and [TotemLibrary (the TotemCore dependency)](https://modrinth.com/mod/totemlibrary) on both client and server. Current releases require Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer, Java 25 or newer, and TotemCore >=0.7.18 and <0.8.0. Other Totem gameplay modules are optional.
